strategy: Investigate completion order independently of spinner appearance; keep repair separate and retain independent CSV drafting.

nudges.purpose: Give the next worker discriminating evidence about the reported late-A overwrite before any repair.
nudges.deliverable:
One local diagnostic note with an event/state table. Use distinct A-text/B-text payloads; translate the supplied assignments literally, without guards or cancellation. Record selectedId, header, details and spinner.hidden after each event:
1. select(A), select(B), resolve(B), resolve(A).
2. Non-overlapping control: select(A), resolve(A), select(B), resolve(B).
3. Alternate overlap: select(A), select(B), resolve(A), resolve(B).
Mark arbitrary initial model state as an assumption. Identify the first conflicting completion write, not merely the final state. An optional Python model must include its actual command/output if executed. Do not include a repair.
understanding: select sets selectedId/header synchronously; each completion writes details and hides the spinner unconditionally.

branches.observation: Late A overwrites displayed B; the non-overlapping control does not.
branches.rationale: Return evidence for a separately scoped repair proposal.

branches.observation: Literal tracing does not reproduce the report or needs an unsupported assumption.
branches.rationale: Return the falsifying trace or assumption; revise the hypothesis before repair planning.

do_not: Do not change the source/model to force a conclusion, apply a repair, or treat spinner appearance as record-identity evidence.

success.observable: The table reproduces or falsifies H-STALE for synthetic-v1 and names the first conflicting write. Evidence is labeled supplied, source-derived, model-executed or NOT_RUN.
success.negative_case: The non-overlapping control should avoid the late overwrite. If it fails, inspect model assumptions. Alternate overlap can end at B despite an intermediate A/header-B mismatch; final-state agreement alone is insufficient. Contradictory evidence must change the conclusion.

missing: Actual product source and browser/backend access; ordinary pointer and keyboard evidence.
uncertainty.return_with: Return the trace, assumptions and any execution restriction. Python modeling cannot establish JavaScript runtime, actual navigation or product acceptance. Reserve unspecified loading/reselection policy.
independent_work: N-CSV: draft unresolved export choices now; do not wait for this investigation.

required: Source revision, tables, assumptions and command/output only if executed; mark unrun checks NOT_RUN.
Hypothesis status with source-linked reasoning, unresolved product evidence and no repair claim.
report.next_action: Return the diagnosis to the Designer for separate repair planning; N-CSV remains eligible.

nudges.purpose: Keep the pending independent CSV request actionable while the record-display investigation proceeds.
nudges.deliverable: One local CSV specification checklist with columns/order and delimiter explicitly unresolved, plus a short draft clarification covering representative data, header naming, quoting/escaping, newlines and text encoding. Distinguish proposed review questions from supplied requirements. Do not send the questions or implement export.
understanding: No columns or delimiter were supplied; standards or personal defaults cannot establish Owner choices.
CSV preparation is independent of the record completion-order diagnosis.

do_not: Do not invent columns, delimiter, acceptance defaults or export behavior.
Do not edit product code or send the draft clarification externally.
Do not make this work wait for N-ONE.

success.observable: The checklist retains the pending export request and explicitly names missing columns/order and delimiter; draft questions are reviewable local text and claims stop at specification preparation.
success.negative_case: A purported completed export or an apparently final specification with invented columns/delimiter fails this task, even if it looks conventional.

missing: Representative export data and agreement on encoding/quoting/newline details.
uncertainty.return_with: Return a short local checklist and draft questions for later Owner review; leave those choices unresolved.
independent_work: N-ONE remains eligible regardless of CSV choices.

required: Quote the supplied lack of columns and delimiters.
List explicit unresolved choices, proposed questions and next required input.
State no export was implemented and no message was sent.
report.next_action: When Owner specification and implementation authority become available, draft a separate export implementation nudge; do not tie it to record-race completion.

remaining: Actual diagnostic execution; separately scoped repair if supported.
